key: \PN!
en: \PN!
ja: \PN!

key: FERN: Hah... You didn't think you'd seen the last of me, did you?
en: FERN: Hah... You didn't think you'd seen the last of me, did you?
ja: ファーン: はっ……オレのこと、もう見納めだとでも思ってたか?

key: Not by a long shot!
en: Not by a long shot!
ja: まだまだ甘いぜ!

key: You might've thrashed me, put my pride in the dirt, and kicked me into a well of shame from which I'm still trying to crawl out...
en: You might've thrashed me, put my pride in the dirt, and kicked me into a well of shame from which I'm still trying to crawl out...
ja: お前はオレをボコボコにして、プライドを地に落として、今もまだはい上がろうとしてる恥の井戸に蹴り落とした……

key: ...But I'm still here!
en: ...But I'm still here!
ja: ……でも、オレはまだここにいる!

key: If you think all that's gonna keep me down, you've got another thing coming!
en: If you think all that's gonna keep me down, you've got another thing coming!
ja: それでオレが立ち直れないとでも思ってるなら、大間違いだぜ!

key: Actually, to be honest...
en: Actually, to be honest...
ja: てか、正直に言うと……

key: A part of me is glad that you kicked Lin in her stupid face and became the champion.
en: A part of me is glad that you kicked Lin in her stupid face and became the champion.
ja: お前がリンのバカな顔面を蹴り飛ばしてチャンピオンになったこと、正直ちょっとうれしいんだよな。

key: It's a lot less embarrassing to have lost to you if you're on the top.
en: It's a lot less embarrassing to have lost to you if you're on the top.
ja: お前がトップにいるなら、負けたのもそんなに恥ずかしくないし。

key: And you put that bitch in her place to boot.
en: And you put that bitch in her place to boot.
ja: それに、あの女に思い知らせてやったのも良かったし。

key: So thanks for that.
en: So thanks for that.
ja: だから、それには感謝してるぜ。

key: They did everything they could for my face, but this is the best it's gonna get, they said.
en: They did everything they could for my face, but this is the best it's gonna get, they said.
ja: オレの顔のこと、できる限りのことはやってくれたけど、これが限界だって言われたよ。

key: At first I was ashamed to even go out in public.
en: At first I was ashamed to even go out in public.
ja: 最初は、人前に出るのすら恥ずかしかった。

key: But you know what?
en: But you know what?
ja: でもな?

key: This is still my face-- the only one I got!
en: This is still my face-- the only one I got!
ja: これでも、オレの顔だ――他に代わりはないんだよ!

key: And if I can't be proud of it, then that's everyone else's problem!
en: And if I can't be proud of it, then that's everyone else's problem!
ja: それを誇りに思えないっていうなら、それは他の奴らの問題だ!

key: I'll wear my mistakes loudly, and keep on smiling anyway!
en: I'll wear my mistakes loudly, and keep on smiling anyway!
ja: オレは自分の失敗を堂々と身にまとって、それでも笑い続けてやる!

key: ...So, you heard too, right?
en: ...So, you heard too, right?
ja: ……で、お前も聞いたよな?

key: About the Mewtwo.
en: About the Mewtwo.
ja: ミュウツーの話。

key: I'll have you know I haven't just been sitting on my ass all this time.
en: I'll have you know I haven't just been sitting on my ass all this time.
ja: オレだって、ずっと尻を落ち着けてたわけじゃないんだぜ。

key: Just as you've been out there catching Legendaries and putting out fires, so have I!
en: Just as you've been out there catching Legendaries and putting out fires, so have I!
ja: お前が伝説のポケモンを捕まえたり、火消しに走り回ったりしてる間、オレだって同じことをしてたんだ!

key: Don't get comfortable-- I'm coming for your champion title!
en: Don't get comfortable-- I'm coming for your champion title!
ja: 油断すんなよ――お前のチャンピオンの座、いずれいただくからな!

key: And this Mewtwo is a stepping stone on my way to beating you.
en: And this Mewtwo is a stepping stone on my way to beating you.
ja: このミュウツーは、お前を倒すための足がかりってわけだ。

key: ...So, I can't take your title here and now, but what do you say to a casual battle?
en: ...So, I can't take your title here and now, but what do you say to a casual battle?
ja: ……まあ、今ここで称号を奪うことはできないけど、軽くバトルしないか?

key: Winner gets the first shot at Mewtwo.
en: Winner gets the first shot at Mewtwo.
ja: 勝った方が、ミュウツーに先に挑戦する権利を得る。

key: Let's put 'em up!
en: Let's put 'em up!
ja: やろうぜ!

key: ...Hmph.
en: ...Hmph.
ja: ……ふん

key: FERN: ...Tch.
en: FERN: ...Tch.
ja: ファーン: ……チッ。

key: Good match, champ.
en: Good match, champ.
ja: いい勝負だったぜ、チャンプ。

key: You beat me fair and square this time.
en: You beat me fair and square this time.
ja: 今回は、正々堂々とお前に負けたよ。

key: Next time will be different, but I'm sticking to my word; first shot at Mewtwo is all yours.
en: Next time will be different, but I'm sticking to my word; first shot at Mewtwo is all yours.
ja: 次は違う結果になるだろうけど、約束は守る。ミュウツーへの初挑戦権は、お前のものだ。

key: I'm still coming to clean up your sloppy seconds though!
en: I'm still coming to clean up your sloppy seconds though!
ja: でも、お前の後片付けは、オレがきっちりやりに来るからな!

key: Race you there!
en: Race you there!
ja: 競争だ!
